Description: Infection of susceptible individuals at a rate λ(t), where λ(t) = β * (I1(t) + I2(t)) / N.
Progression from the first to the second exposed stage at a daily rate σ.
Progression from the second exposed stage to the first infectious stage at a daily rate σ.
Progression from the first to the second infectious stage at a daily rate γ.

Name: π
Description: Initial proportion of the population who is susceptible.

Name: λ0
Description: Initial infection rate at time t=0.

Name: ψ
Description: Exponential growth rate of the epidemic at its start.

Name: β
Description: Constant transmission rate at which new infections take place given a contact.

Name: σ
Description: Daily rate of transition through exposed compartments (E1 to E2, and E2 to I1), leading to an average incubation period of 2/σ days.

Name: γ
Description: Daily rate of transition through infectious compartments (I1 to I2, and I2 to R), leading to an average infectious period of 2/γ days.

Name: p_ICU
Description: Probability of ICU admission given infection.

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial observation model of ICU admissions.

Name: µ_ICU|E
Description: Mean time from infection to ICU admission.

Name: σ^2_ICU|E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission.
